annual_basis_note: The 808,462 (2023) figure is the ARSEPAM-registered/fiscalized intermunicipal waterway passenger count for the whole state of Amazonas, of which Manaus is the hub — it undercounts total river movement (informal/unregistered trips, urban crossings like CEASA↔Careiro, tour traffic and Marina do Davi community lanchas are not all captured). The 3.5M/yr Terminal Manaus Moderna figure is 2029 design capacity, not observed demand. FX basis: 5.0727 BRL/USD (BCB PTAX 2026-07-15).
